errors.evidence: The value for the 6-digit (blue) line at iteration 1 is approximately 38%, not 40%. While close, it is the first of several inaccuracies.
The value for the 6-digit (blue) line at iteration 2 is approximately 69%, which is significantly different from the stated 65%.

errors.evidence: The 6-digit (blue) line does not plateau. It continues to increase steadily from approximately 88% at iteration 4 to about 94% at iteration 9. Describing this as a plateau is a major misrepresentation of the trend.
The value for the 5-digit (orange) line at iteration 2 is approximately 79%, not 70%. This is a substantial error.
The value for the 5-digit (orange) line at iteration 3 is approximately 82%, where it intersects the other line. Stating it is 78% is inaccurate.
